bear_case.title: China dominates cells
bear_case.description: In global EV batteries, CATL (39.9%, 242.7 GWh, +25.3% YoY) and BYD (14.4%, 87.7 GWh) held a combined 54.3% of H1 2026 shipments; in grid storage specifically, global ESS shipments hit 461.3 GWh in H1 2026 (+71% YoY) with CATL alone holding a 35% share of that segment. North America/Europe/other now account for 56% of ESS shipment destinations (vs 43.9% China) for the first time — a sign of geographic diversification, but manufacturing scale still sits overwhelmingly with Chinese cell makers.

bear_case.title: Policy whiplash
bear_case.description: Section 301 duties on non-EV lithium-ion (grid BESS) cells jumped from 7.5% to 25% effective Jan 1, 2026, pushing the effective combined US import tariff on Chinese ESS batteries to ~58.4% (from 40.9%); new FEOC rules cap Chinese-sourced content at 45% of manufacturing cost for ITC eligibility.

bear_case.title: Margin compression
bear_case.description: Fluence's Q3 FY26 print is the freshest evidence: GAAP gross margin fell to 5.1% from 14.8% on contract-manufacturing delays and upfront battery-supply costs, forcing a guidance cut and a ~16% share-price drop — on top of Tesla's own Q2 energy-segment margin nearly halving (39.5% → 20.4%). Software attach remains the differentiator for integrators; hardware is under real pressure from Chinese cost structures.

bear_case.title: Solid-state timelines
bear_case.description: QuantumScape's Honda pact is a vote of confidence but still carries no production license or volume commitment; 2026 adjusted EBITDA-loss guidance remains $250–275M and shares are down more than 50% YTD, underscoring how far off meaningful revenue still is.

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.note: Q2 orders +88% YoY to $24.2B, backlog $176B en route to $200B by 2027, and >$5B of YTD data-center orders (more than 2x all of 2025) via new AWS and Microsoft framework deals — grid equipment remains the physical bottleneck, not storage cells. Overlaps your Nuclear sleeve.

positions.name: Tesla
positions.note: The Houston-area Megapack/Megablock factory is on track for H2 2026 deliveries and a 500 MWh Megapack just went live with Ørsted in Texas — tangible proof the ramp is real even as Q2 energy margin dipped to 20.4% on a one-time warranty charge. Overlaps your Robotics sleeve.

positions.name: Fluence Energy
positions.note: Q3 FY26 GAAP gross margin collapsed to 5.1% from 14.8% on contract-manufacturing delays and upfront battery-supply costs, forcing a guidance cut to $2.9–3.1B revenue and a ~16% share-price drop; the record $6.4B backlog says demand is fine, but the margin path is now genuinely unresolved.

positions.name: Eos Energy
positions.note: Zinc chemistry sidesteps the lithium supply chain and backlog hit a record $807M this quarter, but a $275.7M net loss and gross margin still at -71% mean it remains an unproven, dilution-prone bet.

positions.name: QuantumScape
positions.note: Solid-state would reset the sector, but the Honda pact still carries no production license or volume commitment and shares are down >50% YTD against a maintained $250–275M EBITDA-loss guide.

positions.name: Enphase
positions.note: Structurally impaired by US residential-solar policy changes — a different problem from the storage thesis, and Q2 revenue still down 20% YoY despite the battery-attach bright spot.

positions.name: Stem Inc
positions.note: Repeated restructurings and a software story that has not converted into durable revenue; Q2 results due Aug 12 with nothing yet to change the picture.
